title: Implement Zero-State Initialization and Emergency Brake Protocol
executiveSummary: Integrate mandatory zero-state purging and undocumented state escalation into server.js and the MQL5 bridge to prevent NaN contamination. This ensures deterministic behavior and immediate bottom-up alerting for any unhandled states.
actionPlan: Refactor server.js execution loop to enforce a 'purgeState()' function that resets all indicator variables to zero/null before each cycle, preventing NaN propagation.
Implement an 'EmergencyBrake' handler in the MQL5 bridge that detects undocumented states and triggers an immediate WebSocket alert to the Cockpit UI instead of attempting silent recovery.
Update Tab13Docs.jsx to display the current state of the Zero-Init protocol and log any Emergency Brake activations for auditability.
